bio: Behind the port, in the antique dealer neighbourhood, a disciple of Yves Camdeborde is at the helm of this friendly wine bar. The chef prepares lovely Mediterranean sharing plates, concocted with ultra-fresh produce. It is delicious and hearty, and the wallet doesn't take too heavy a hit. A hundred or so lively wines feature on the list, also at reasonable prices. Open all day from noon (no reservations taken)....
